source.author: verg
source.text: Ipse atri velleris agnam Aeneas matri Eumenidum magnaeque sorori ense ferit, sterilemque tibi.
source.text_original: Ipse atri velleris agnam / Aeneas matri Eumenidum magnaeque sorori / ense ferit, sterilemque tibi.
source.text_english: Aeneas himself strikes with his sword a black-fleeced lamb for the mother of the Eumenides and her great sister, and a barren one for you.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text_english: Whom does he strike with his sword?
